observation.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://venice.ai/" -o /tmp/vm.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(turnstile|recaptcha|hcaptcha|0x4AAAAA[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}|6L[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{25,})" /tmp/vm.html | sort -u | head -8; echo "=== signup page ==="; for u in "https://venice.ai/sign-up" "https://venice.ai/register" "https://venice.ai/auth/signup"; do printf "%-32s " "$u"; curl -s -o /tmp/s.html -w "[%{http_code}] " --max-time 25 "$u"; grep -oiE "(turnstile|recaptcha|hcaptcha|0x4AAAAA[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})" /tmp/s.html | sort -u | head -3 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
